# Intel
> Intel provides processors, platforms, software, and enterprise technologies for PCs, data centers, AI, networking, edge, and embedded systems.

Intel’s site spans product information, developer documentation, software toolkits, support resources, and newsroom content across consumer, enterprise, and embedded computing domains.

## Products
- [Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors.html): Overview of Intel CPU families for desktop, laptop, workstation, and server systems.
- [Intel Core Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core.html): Product details and positioning for Intel Core consumer and commercial processors.
- [Intel Xeon Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon.html): Server and workstation processor portfolio for data center and enterprise workloads.
- [Intel Arc Graphics](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/discrete-gpus/arc.html): Discrete graphics products for gaming, creation, and AI-enhanced workloads.
- [FPGAs and Programmable Devices](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/fpga.html): Programmable logic solutions, SoCs, and development resources for FPGA platforms.
- [Ethernet Products](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/ethernet.html): Network adapters, controllers, and infrastructure connectivity products.
- [Wireless Products](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/wireless.html): Wi-Fi and wireless connectivity solutions for client and embedded platforms.

## AI and Data Center
- [AI Overview](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/artificial-intelligence/overview.html): Intel AI technologies, hardware, software, and deployment use cases.
- [Data Center Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/data-center/overview.html): Infrastructure technologies for compute, storage, networking, and cloud environments.
- [Intel Gaudi AI Accelerators](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/ai-accelerators/gaudi.html): AI accelerator portfolio for training and inference in data center deployments.
- [Intel Tiber Portfolio](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/tiber/overview.html): Cloud, software, and platform services supporting enterprise and AI workflows.
- [Edge Computing](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/edge-computing/overview.html): Edge technologies for industrial, retail, vision, and distributed AI applications.
- [Network and Edge](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/network-io.html): Networking and I/O technologies for telecom, edge, and infrastructure systems.

## Developers
- [Intel Developer Zone](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/overview.html): Central hub for Intel developer tools, documentation, SDKs, and community resources.
- [Documentation](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/documentation/overview.html): Technical documentation for Intel software, hardware, and platform development.
- [API and Reference](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/api-documentation.html): Entry points to Intel API documentation and technical reference materials.
- [Code Samples](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/open/code-samples.html): Sample code and implementation examples for Intel development technologies.
- [Open Source at Intel](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/open-source/overview.html): Intel open source projects, contributions, and ecosystem initiatives.
- [Developer Catalog](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/overview.html): Browse Intel development tools, libraries, compilers, and performance analyzers.

## Software and Toolkits
- [Intel oneAPI](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/overview.html): Unified programming model and toolkits for CPU, GPU, FPGA, and accelerator development.
- [oneAPI Base Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/base-toolkit.html): Core compilers, libraries, and analysis tools for cross-architecture development.
- [oneAPI HPC Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/hpc-toolkit.html): Performance tools and libraries for high-performance computing applications.
- [Intel Distribution of OpenVINO Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/openvino-toolkit/overview.html): Toolkit for optimizing and deploying computer vision and AI inference workloads.
- [Intel Fortran Compiler](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/fortran-compiler.html): Fortran compiler resources for scientific, engineering, and HPC software development.
- [Intel DPC++/C++ Compiler](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/dpc-compiler.html): SYCL and C++ compiler for heterogeneous programming across Intel architectures.
- [Intel VTune Profiler](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/vtune-profiler.html): Performance profiling and bottleneck analysis for applications and systems.
- [Intel Advisor](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/advisor.html): Vectorization, threading, and roofline analysis for code optimization.

## Hardware and Embedded Development
- [Intel FPGA Developer Center](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/fpga/development-tools.html): Development tools and resources for Intel FPGA and programmable logic workflows.
- [Quartus Prime Software](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/fpga/development-tools/quartus-prime.html): FPGA design software for synthesis, place-and-route, and device programming.
- [Embedded Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/embedded/overview.html): Embedded computing platforms and lifecycle-focused product information.
- [Intel NUC](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/nuc.html): Small-form-factor computing platforms for edge, business, and enthusiast use cases.
- [Intel vPro Platform](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/architecture-and-technology/vpro/vpro-platform-general.html): Business PC platform technologies for manageability, security, and fleet deployment.
- [Intel Evo Edition](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/systems-devices/laptops/intel-evo.html): Laptop platform specification focused on responsiveness, battery life, and mobility.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support.html): Main support portal for drivers, downloads, troubleshooting, and product assistance.
- [Download Center](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html): Drivers, firmware, BIOS, and software downloads for Intel products.
- [Product Specifications](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/sku.html): Searchable Intel ARK database for detailed product specifications and comparisons.
- [Warranty Information](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/topics/warranty.html): Warranty policies, coverage details, and service information for Intel products.
- [Processor Identification Utility](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000005567/processors.html): Utility and guidance for identifying installed Intel processors and capabilities.
- [Support Community](https://community.intel.com/): Community forums for peer support and Intel product discussions.
- [Drivers and Software](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html): Access software packages, drivers, and update tools for supported hardware.

## Solutions and Industries
- [Business Computing](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/business/overview.html): Intel technologies and platforms for commercial PCs and enterprise client deployments.
- [Cloud Computing](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/cloud-computing/overview.html): Cloud infrastructure guidance, technologies, and workload optimization resources.
- [Retail](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/retail/overview.html): Retail technology solutions for analytics, edge AI, and customer experiences.
- [Industrial](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/industrial/overview.html): Industrial automation and edge computing technologies for manufacturing environments.
- [Automotive](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/automotive/overview.html): Automotive compute, AI, and in-vehicle platform technologies.
- [Education](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/education/overview.html): Education-focused technology initiatives, devices, and digital learning resources.

## Newsroom and Insights
- [Newsroom](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/home.html): Corporate news, announcements, executive updates, and media resources.
- [Press Releases](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/news.html): Official Intel announcements covering products, partnerships, and company developments.
- [Intel Blogs](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/blogs.html): Articles and commentary from Intel leaders and subject matter experts.
- [Events](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/events/overview.html): Intel conferences, webinars, and event information for developers and customers.
- [Stories](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/stories.html): Feature stories highlighting technology, research, and customer impact.
- [Media Kit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/resources/media-kit.html): Brand assets, executive bios, and media resources for press use.

- [About Intel](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/company-overview/company-overview.html): Overview of Intel’s business, strategy, and corporate mission.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.intc.com/): Financial reports, filings, earnings materials, and investor communications.
- [Careers](https://jobs.intel.com/): Job listings, recruiting information, and career opportunities at Intel.
- [Corporate Responsibility](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/corporate-responsibility/overview.html): Sustainability, governance, and social impact programs across Intel operations.
- [Intel Foundry](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/foundry/overview.html): Foundry services, manufacturing technologies, and ecosystem offerings for chipmakers.
- [Contact Intel](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/contact-us.html): Contact options for sales, support, and corporate inquiries.
